operations.title: Entry 657 — The Complete Physical Source Occupies the Rank-Twenty Residue Quotient
operations.locator: src/ledger/20260818-657 The Complete Physical Source Occupies the Rank-Twenty Residue Quotient.md

operations.title: The complete physical five-pole source has nonzero image in the rank-twenty G12 residue quotient
operations.statement: For each rank-thirty-five five-pole family, deletion has rank fifteen and the G12 residue quotient rank twenty. The source residue has three generically nonzero normalized conductor components, hence the complete source is not contained in the deletion submodule.

operations.title: Deletion-residue occupancy gate for the complete physical source
operations.method: Combine the rank identity 35=15+20 with the three nonzero normalized conductor resultants and zero mixed occurrence component.
